briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ and S&P500 both +0.3%), a neutral session with no broad risk-on or risk-off signal. Rather than forcing cash to work across the board, we picked only the two candidates (GOOGL and F) showing complete multi-signal confirmation, leaving one slot open for a cleaner future setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confirmation means waiting for several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs. moving average, and trading volume — to all agree before making a trade, rather than acting on just one promising number. It reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move. Today we only bought stocks where every key signal lined up, even though the overall market was flat.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號確認是指在進場前，等待多個獨立的技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、股價與均線的關係、以及成交量）同時發出一致訊號，而不是只看單一指標就貿然進場。這樣可以降低追逐假訊號或短暫波動的風險。今日即使大盤表現平淡，我們仍只選擇所有關鍵訊號同步確認的股票進行買入。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly higher with NASDAQ and the S&P 500 both up about 0.3%, a muted, directionless session rather than a decisive move. No major market-moving headlines stood out today, so trading largely reflected routine positioning rather than a reaction to news. With no strong catalyst, the modest gains suggest investors are holding steady ahead of clearer signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股主要指數今日小幅走高，納斯達克及標普500均上漲約0.3%，走勢溫和且方向不明顯。市場上並未出現重大消息面衝擊，今日的交易情緒主要反映一般倉位調整，而非對特定新聞的反應。在缺乏明確催化劑的情況下，溫和漲幅顯示投資者在等待更清晰的方向訊號前選擇按兵不動。

trades.reasoning: Full signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge all align, the clean setup our strategy memory calls for.
Same four-signal confirmation (RSI in bullish zone, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) makes this a disciplined second high-conviction add with open slots and cash available.
